title: Sharma (1996) slope, 11 ft dry tension crack instead of the zero-strength cap

meta.title: Sharma (1996) slope, 11 ft dry tension crack instead of the zero-strength cap
meta.notes: The V082c slope with the zero-strength cap replaced by an 11 ft dry tension crack (Table 27.4, analysis 3), on the V082c circle; phreatic correction. Converted to SI.

source.reference: Sharma (1996); Malkawi et al. (2001). Verification manual of a commercial slope stability program.
source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V082a (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: The water table is the one in the manual's Fig. 27.1, its node markers read from the figure calibrated on 12 labeled ground vertices (residual at most 0.3 ft): (63, 73), (82.95, 78.08), (103.79, 82.02), (121.66, 84.48), (139.61, 86.93), (200, 92.8) ft. An earlier tracing lay 1.1–1.7 ft higher from x = 75 to 200 ft and gave every method 1.8–1.9 % low.

The Malkawi, Hassan & Sarma (2001) paper on non-circular surfaces (J. Geotech. Geoenviron. Eng. 127(8)) does not contain this slope; the reference is probably their companion paper on circular surfaces in the Can. Geotech. J. (2001), not yet checked. The geometry is Wright & Roecker's (1984) Example F, which V082c's coordinates reproduce in feet.
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.

porePressureHead = phreatic-correction en los checks de la fuente: ogs solo tiene la altura vertical (E3), que es también la opción por defecto de cSlope y la que usa el harness (no emite porePressureHead). Con la corrección freática cSlope da el FS de Bishop en 1,5338 (V082a) y 1,5126 (V082b); con la vertical, 1,5204 y 1,4994, que siguen dentro de la tolerancia del valor publicado.
grieta de tracción: profundidad 3.3528 m, fracción de agua 0 (cSlope tensionCrackDepth y tensionCrackWater); en ogs es `analysis.tension_crack {depth, water_fill}` (F5.2).
